label: vector-store — 4 LanceDbVectorBackend fixes (SpaceInvariantError, getTable, return type, db param)
summary: Fixed 4 issues in LanceDbVectorBackend: SpaceInvariantError thrown on dim mismatch, getTable() throws on missing space instead of auto-creating, openLanceDbVectorStore returns LanceDbVectorBackend & VectorBackend, db param made required.

changes.kind: added SpaceInvariantError import; replaced generic Error with SpaceInvariantError in upsert()
changed getTable() to throw on missing space instead of auto-creating via ensureSpace()
changed openLanceDbVectorStore return type from LanceDbVectorBackend to LanceDbVectorBackend & VectorBackend
made db param required (removed ?) in openLanceDbVectorStore config type

handoff_notes: lancedb.ts is an untracked file — ensure it is staged before commit

InMemoryLanceTable.upsert() has its own dimension check with generic Error (internal guard, not SpaceInvariantError) — this is correct because InMemoryLanceTable is a private implementation detail; the public-facing LanceDbVectorBackend.upsert() now correctly throws SpaceInvariantError
getTable() now throws on missing space — callers (knn, delete, get, iter) require ensureSpace() to be called first, matching the SqliteVectorBackend contract
backlog_entries: InMemoryLanceTable.upsert() throws generic Error on internal dim mismatch — consider promoting to SpaceInvariantError if InMemoryLanceTable becomes public
